notes.title: Moving to Early Access
notes.notes:
[p]Hello! Thanks to all who have wishlisted the game and are following the progress of Craterlands. Craterlands is a huge project for me, and while it's feeling like a complete game with a lot of content I've decided to move to Early Access with a release next summer. This should give me time to implement on my core features and fully create the huge world I've set out to make. Also, would love to get feedback from players on what they would like to see in the game. 

I've already gotten some good feedback from the Demo and one feature that has been widely asked for is Fishing! I have the basics implemented so far so I will be working on adding this into the next Demo update.
